purpose: Verify that each answer claim is judged only against the evidence cited by that claim.

cases.question: Which objectives does BERT use during pre-training?
cases.expected_answer: BERT uses masked language modelling and next-sentence prediction.
cases.answer: BERT pre-trains with masked language modelling and next-sentence prediction [S1].

sources.chunk_text: BERT is pre-trained using two unsupervised tasks: masked language modelling and next-sentence prediction.

cases.question: How does LoRA adapt a pretrained model?
cases.expected_answer: LoRA freezes pretrained weights and learns low-rank update matrices.
cases.answer: LoRA freezes pretrained weights and learns low-rank updates [S1].

sources.chunk_text: BERT is pre-trained with masked language modelling and next-sentence prediction.
LoRA freezes the pretrained model weights and injects trainable low-rank decomposition matrices into each layer.

cases.question: Does Donut require a separate OCR engine?
cases.expected_answer: Donut is an OCR-free document understanding model.
cases.answer: Donut performs OCR-free document understanding [S1, S2].

sources.chunk_text: A vision transformer applies a transformer encoder to sequences of image patches.
Donut is an OCR-free end-to-end transformer for visual document understanding.

cases.question: What does Nougat convert document images into?
cases.expected_answer: Nougat converts document images into markup.
cases.answer: Nougat converts document images into markup.

sources.chunk_text: Nougat is a neural network that converts scientific document images into a markup language.

cases.question: What modalities does LayoutLMv3 mask?
cases.expected_answer: LayoutLMv3 applies masking to text and image content.
cases.answer: LayoutLMv3 jointly learns text and image masking [S9].

sources.chunk_text: LayoutLMv3 uses unified text and image masking objectives during pre-training.

cases.question: What happened to factual accuracy after retrieval augmentation?
cases.expected_answer: The reported experiment improved factual accuracy.
cases.answer: The cited experiment reports that retrieval augmentation reduced factual accuracy [S1].

sources.chunk_text: Adding retrieved passages improved factual accuracy from 71 percent to 79 percent in the reported experiment.

cases.question: How does ColBERT represent and compare passages?
cases.expected_answer: ColBERT keeps token-level representations and uses late interaction.
cases.answer: ColBERT uses late interaction between query and passage representations [S1]. It represents every passage with one pooled dense vector [S1].

sources.chunk_text: ColBERT independently encodes query and document tokens, then applies a late-interaction MaxSim operator over their token-level embeddings rather than pooling each passage into one vector.
